title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 24
paragraphs: Now Scythes the ruler of the Zanclaeans escaped from Inyx to Himera, and from there he came to Asia and went up to the court of Darius; and Darius considered him the most righteous of all the men who had come up to him from Hellas, for he was given leave by the king and went off to Sicily, and again came back from Sicily to the king; and finally he ended his life among the Persians in old age, possessed of great wealth. The Samians, then, having got rid of the rule of the Medes, had gained for themselves without effort the fair city of Zancle.
